criteria.reasoning: The deliverables table shows "D1 | Learners enrolled | 120 | 131 | Met."

The memo reports D2 as "Met", measuring against "75% of the 120-learner enrollment target = 90" with "94 completers." That is the comparison against the 120 target that the criterion fails; against the 131 enrolled, the rate is 71.8%, below 75%.
The memo reports D3 as "61 of 94 = 64.9%" against the 60% target, "Met". It explicitly corrects Marcus: "The rate to report is 64.9%, not 83.6%."
The memo reports D4 as "26 (27 recruited; one has 8 hours) | Met" and notes "26 tutors completed the 12-hour training, not 27."

The memo reports D5 as "Met" with four meetings, counting the "Q4 meeting rescheduled to 2026-07-16". It states "it is the Q4 meeting and counts toward Year 1." The criterion fails any memo that counts the July 16 meeting toward Year 1.

The memo identifies "AP-2242, 2026-05-29, Harborview Taproom... beer and wine service, $640" as barred by Section 6.3. It says the charge "must be moved to unrestricted funds" and excludes it from the totals. The $1,020 Hearthside buffet is correctly treated as allowable.
The table shows "Learner supports | $12,000 | $13,560 | +$1,560 | +13.0% | Yes", and the notes say it needs the Foundation's written approval.

The memo gives the correct variance, −$1,080 (−13.5%). But it marks "No (underspend)" and states "an underspend moves no money onto the line, so it needs no approval." The criterion fails a memo that says the underspend needs no approval.
Only Learner supports is flagged for approval. The memo states "Local travel (−8.1%) and Tutor training (−6.0%) are within 10% and need no approval," and every other line is marked "No."

The table gives Personnel −$1,020 (−1.5%, $66,980), Fringe −$204 (−1.5%, $13,396), Tutor training −$300 (−6.0%, $4,700), Local travel −$290 (−8.1%, $3,310) and Evaluation consultant $0 (0.0%, $9,800). All match the required figures.
The memo states "Allowable Year 1 grant expenses: $118,666 (Renee's ledger total of $119,306 less the $640 unallowable charge)" and "Unspent: $1,334, which carries forward to Year 2."
The memo gives "Friday, August 14, 2026 | Interim report (Year 1) due | 45 days after June 30, 2026."
The memo gives "Wednesday, March 31, 2027 | Last day for the Foundation to receive a no-cost-extension request." The criterion requires April 1, 2027 and names March 31 as a failing date.
The memo gives "Tuesday, September 28, 2027 | Final report due; any unspent grant funds returned with it | 90 days after June 30, 2027."
